listing.title: My First Helpers Coloring Book
listing.subtitle: 30 Big & Easy Community Helper Pages – Firefighter, Doctor, Teacher, Chef & More for Kids Ages 2-5
listing.author: JONNY COLOR
listing.description_html:
Big, bold and easy to color: a first coloring book full of friendly helpers!

Little hands color 30 pictures of the people who help us and the things they use, from a firefighter, a doctor and a teacher to a chef, a bus driver and a mail carrier. Every page has one big, simple picture with extra-thick lines and a happy face, so small hands can color inside the lines, and each picture's name is written in big letters to color too.

Inside you'll find:

  • Helpers who keep us safe and well: Firefighter, Police Officer, Doctor, Nurse, Vet, Dentist, Lifeguard and Crossing Guard
  • Helpers who teach, build and fix: Teacher, Librarian, Scientist, Builder, Painter, Mechanic and Gardener
  • Helpers around town: Mail Carrier, Delivery Driver, Bus Driver, Pilot, Chef, Recycling Worker and Hairdresser
  • The things they use: Fire Hydrant, First Aid Kit, Toolbox, Traffic Cone, Stethoscope, Hard Hat, Letter and Doctor's Bag
  • One large picture per page with thick outlines
  • Single-sided pages with a blank back, so markers won't bleed onto the next picture
  • Big 8.5 x 11 inch pages and a "Great job!" certificate at the end

A fun, screen-free activity for toddlers and preschoolers ages 2 to 5.

Part of the my first step series.
